title: events-feature-using-fees.html
content: Limitation Do not use the Virtual Terminal to process a Transaction that includes Fees (Payment Processing or Tax). Fees are not supported by the Virtual Terminal. IMPORTANT NOTE The process for using {{variable.Object_Fee}} s works the same whether you use {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s or {{variable.Object_EventItemSession}} s. For the examples below, we used {{variable.Object_EventItem}} s. Prerequisite Before you can add {{variable.Object_Fee}} s to your {{variable.Object_Event}} , you must add the following fields to the {{variable.Object_Event}} page layout. Go to the relevant {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} . Click Edit Object .   Click the Page Layouts tab. Click Event Layout. Click the Fields tab. In the Quick Fix box, enter and click “Fee."   Drag and drop the following fields on the page layout. {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFeeCalculatType}} Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Add a Payment Processing Fee to an Event Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentProcesFee}} field. Search for and select an existing {{variable.Object_Fee}} , OR click + New Fee . To create a new {{variable.Object_Fee}} , fill in the following fields. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeeName}} (required): IMPORTANT: This field will be displayed on checkout. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeePercentage}} (required): The value must be between 0 and 100. {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} : If you check the {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} box, all newly created {{variable.Object_Event}} s will use this {{variable.Object_Fee}} when processing credit card payments.   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} to update the {{variable.Object_Event}} .   Short-Term Limitation Displaying the {{variable.Field_Fee_FeeName}} is only available with Tabbed, Full-width, Simple, and BYO CSS UI. It will be extended to Dynamic UI in a future release. Also, please note that the {{variable.Object_Fee}} will not be applied to any other {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} s at this time. What Your Attendees Will See In this example, the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} ’s Ticket {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} = “200.00,” and the {{variable.Object_Fee}} record contains the following information. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeeName}} = “Payment Processing Fee” {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} = “Payment Processing” {{variable.Field_Fee_FeePercentage}} = “2.50” Click the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}} . The “Starting from” price is based on the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} with the lowest {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} . Click Get Tickets .   Add a Ticket to the cart and click Checkout .   Fill in the Attendee details and click Payment .   Enter the payment details. In the Summary column, you’ll see the cost breakdown.   Click Pay .   Once the credit card processing fee and payment have been processed during checkout, a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} will be created for the {{variable.Object_Fee}} and related to the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} . The {{variable.Object_LineItem}} will also be visible on the DocumentLink. Add a Tax Fee to an Event Calculated at Checkout Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} field. Search for an existing {{variable.Object_Fee}} or click + New Fee . To create a new {{variable.Object_Fee}} record, complete the following fields. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeeName}} (required): IMPORTANT: This field will be displayed on checkout. {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} - If you check the {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} box, all newly created {{variable.Object_Event}} s will use this {{variable.Object_Fee}} for adding taxes. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeePercentage}} {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} = “Tax” {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}} = "Calculated at Checkout" (The tax will not be shown until the final payment screen. Note: Taxes are always displayed separately on the final payment screen.)   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} to save the changes to your {{variable.Object_Event}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} to make sure the changes are published on the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage.   What Your Attendee Will See In this example, the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} ’s Ticket {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} = “200.00,” and the {{variable.Object_Fee}} record contains the following information. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeeName}} = “Sales Tax” {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} = “Tax” {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}} = “Calculated at Checkout” {{variable.Field_Fee_FeePercentage}} = “7.5%” Click the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}} . The “Starting from” price is based on the Ticket ( {{variable.Object_EventItem}} ) with the lowest {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} , plus the tax due. Click Get Tickets .   Add the General Admission Ticket to the cart and click Checkout .   Enter the Attendee details and click Payment .   Enter the payment details. In the Order Summary column, you'll see the cost breakdown.   Click Pay .   Once the tax amount and payment have been processed, a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} will be created for the {{variable.Object_Fee}} and related to the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} . The {{variable.Object_LineItem}} will also be visible on the DocumentLink. Tax-Inclusive Pricing Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} field. Search for an existing {{variable.Object_Fee}} or click + New Fee . To create a new {{variable.Object_Fee}} record, complete the following fields. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeeName}} (required): IMPORTANT: This field will be displayed on checkout. {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} - If you check the {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} box, all newly created {{variable.Object_Event}} s will use this {{variable.Object_Fee}} for adding taxes. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeePercentage}} {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} = “Tax” {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}} = "Tax-Inclusive Pricing" (The advertised price will include tax. Note: Taxes are always displayed separately on the final payment screen.)   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} to save the changes to your {{variable.Object_Event}} . Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} to make sure the changes are published on the {{variable.Object_Event}} webpage.   What Your Attendee Will See In this example, the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} ’s Ticket {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} = “200.00,” and the {{variable.Object_Fee}} record contains the following information. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeeName}} = “State Sales Tax” {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} = “Tax” {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}} = “Tax-Inclusive Pricing” {{variable.Field_Fee_FeePercentage}} = “3.5%” Click the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}} . The “Starting from” price is based on the Ticket ( {{variable.Object_EventItem}} ) with the lowest {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} , plus the tax due. Click Get Tickets .   Add the General Admission Ticket to the cart and click Checkout .   Enter the Attendee details and click Payment .   Enter the payment details. In the Order Summary column, you'll see the cost breakdown.   Click Pay .   Once the tax amount and payment have been processed, a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} will be created for the {{variable.Object_Fee}} and related to the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} . The {{variable.Object_LineItem}} will also be visible on the DocumentLink. Tax-Exempt Event Items In the following examples, you will see an Event with two Event Items, but one of the Event Items is tax-exempt. Tax - Calculated at Checkout Create an Event with two Event Items, but one of the Event Items is tax-exempt. Go to the Event record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} field. Search for an existing Fee or click + New Fee . To create a new Fee record, complete the following fields. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeeName}} (required): IMPORTANT: This field will be displayed on checkout. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeePercentage}} {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} - If you check the {{variable.Field_Fee_DefaultFee}} box, all newly created {{variable.Object_Event}} s will use this {{variable.Object_Fee}} for adding taxes. {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} = “Tax” {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}} - "Calculated at Checkout" (The tax will not be shown until the final payment screen. Note: Taxes are always displayed separately on the final payment screen.)   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} to save the changes to your Event. Click {{variable.Button_Events_Update}} to make sure the changes are published on the Event webpage.   What Your Attendees Will See In this example, the first Event Item’s Ticket {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} = “200.00,” the second tax-exempt Event Item’s {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} = “100.00,” and the Fee record contains the following information. {{variable.Field_Fee_FeeName}} = “Sales Tax” {{variable.Field_Fee_Type}} = “Tax” {{variable.Field_Fee_TaxDisplaySetting}} = “Calculated at Checkout” {{variable.Field_Fee_FeePercentage}} = “7.50%” Click the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}} . The “Starting from” price is based on the Event Item with the lowest Price. Click Get Tickets .   Add the General Admissions Ticket to the cart and click Checkout .   Fill in the Attendee details and click Payment .   Enter the payment details. In the Summary column, you’ll see the cost breakdown.   Click Pay .   Once the credit card processing fee and payment have been processed during checkout, a Line Item will be created for the Fee and related to the Invoice. The Line Item will also be visible on the DocumentLink. Tax - Tax-inclusive Pricing Create an Event with two Event Items, but one of the Event Items is tax-exempt. Go to the Event record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_Event_TaxFee}} field. Search for an existing Fee or click + New Fee .
